cases.steps: 1. Reset F1. 2. save_note(CA,null,"N",NOTE). 3. Close/reopen the store; resolve returned sourceId.
cases.expected: One new CA note; returned text/hash equals NOTE after restart; baseline NA unchanged.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1. 2. Save N100000 to CA with title "Limit". 3. Reload the saved source.
cases.expected: 100,000 code points retained exactly; one source created.

cases.steps: 1. Reset per trial. 2. Submit empty text, N100001, missing course, then CA with session SB. 3. Compare rows to pre-call snapshot.
cases.expected: Empty/oversize -> INVALID_INPUT; absent UUID -> NOT_FOUND; CA/SB -> COURSE_MISMATCH; zero writes.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1. 2. Validate draft D_OK quoting P1[0:len(NOTE)]. 3. Accept and open reference 0.
cases.expected: Valid draft accepted; exact NOTE location/text opens.

cases.steps: 1. Reset per trial. 2. Validate D_OK with one altered quote character, then endOffset+1. 3. Inspect publication.
cases.expected: Both candidates rejected; zero unsupported drafts published.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1. 2. Cite CB passage in CA draft; attempt publish. 3. Confirm-delete accepted CA item source; resolve the removed item ID.
cases.expected: Wrong-course draft rejected; removed item returns NOT_FOUND; no substituted source.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1. 2. Create supported manual card MC. 3. Accept MC; query active practice.
cases.expected: One accepted card is active; answer/quote match stored source.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1. 2. Create MC but do not accept it. 3. Query active practice; reload app.
cases.expected: Zero draft-status cards in practice before or after reload.

cases.steps: 1. Reset per trial. 2. Create MC with a nonexistent source, then quote absent from NOTE. 3. Query saved cards.
cases.expected: Both rejected; zero unsupported active cards or new review states.

cases.steps: 1. Seed F2 vectors under D1. 2. search_evidence(CA,D1,Q,k=3). 3. Compare with float64 dot-product oracle and IDs.
cases.expected: P1 then P2 then P3; no CB result; scores within 0.00001.

cases.steps: 1. Reset per trial. 2. Query k=1,32,0,33. 3. Repeat with 767 values, NaN and zero vector.
cases.expected: Valid k returns <=k; invalid k/vector gives INVALID_INPUT; no publication.

cases.steps: 1. Reset with current profile D1. 2. search_evidence(CA,D2,Q,1). 3. Create empty course CE; submit a flashcard task for CE.
cases.expected: Wrong digest -> MODEL_MISMATCH; empty-course task -> EMPTY_LIBRARY; no mixed vectors.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1 plus managed PDF source. 2. deleteSource with current revision and confirm=true. 3. Inspect search/practice and original PDF hash.
cases.expected: Deleted source absent from search/practice; original PDF unchanged.

cases.steps: 1. Reset managed PDF source. 2. Hold its managed copy open with exclusive lock; delete source. 3. Unlock and restart recovery.
cases.expected: Cleanup pending reported; source unusable immediately; recovery removes copy after unlock.

cases.steps: 1. Reset per trial. 2. Delete with stale revision, then confirm=false. 3. In a fresh run delete while generation is paused before publish.
cases.expected: STALE_LIBRARY then CONFIRM_REQUIRED; zero deletion; raced job cannot publish stale evidence.

cases.steps: 1. Reset; capture network/logs. 2. Save NOTE with consent off; request indexing. 3. Enable verified local stub profile and retry.
cases.expected: Zero cloud-content requests; consent-off blocks model processing; consent-on uses loopback only.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1. 2. Select profile REMOTE (localVerified=false). 3. Request index/generation while recording outbound calls.
cases.expected: LOCAL_POLICY/readiness error; zero content requests sent to remote service.

cases.steps: 1. Put marker SECRET_NOTE in note/prompt/answer. 2. Trigger model/parser failures. 3. Scan every app log for the marker and full payloads.
cases.expected: Zero note, prompt or answer payloads in diagnostic files.

cases.steps: 1. Use clean settings with no keys/accounts/subscriptions. 2. Save note, create/accept manual MC and practice. 3. Record setup requirements.
cases.expected: Manual workflow completes; zero required paid keys or hosted app services.

cases.steps: 1. Reset and stop local model stub/runtime. 2. Request drafting. 3. Save another note and practice MC without signing in.
cases.expected: Model error visible; notes/manual practice work; zero mandatory paid-login/key prompts.

cases.steps: 1. Inspect release source/bundle inventory. 2. Check original code LICENSE and third-party notices. 3. Repeat checklist on a copy missing LICENSE.
cases.expected: Actual release retains MIT notice; missing-notice copy fails release checklist.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1 for each F01-F10. 2. Inject the named fault from Fault_Catalog.json. 3. Restart/recover and compare committed NOTE hashes.
cases.expected: 10/10 trials lose zero unintended committed notes; each named failure recorded.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1. 2. Lock writer for >2 seconds; attempt save. 3. Inject migration failure after backup; reopen old data.
cases.expected: Failed write rolls back; old committed notes survive; failed migration never silently resets DB.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1; pause a job before final commit. 2. Terminate app process. 3. Restart, read note and get_job.
cases.expected: Original NOTE unchanged; unfinished job failed/INTERRUPTED; zero partial active drafts.

cases.steps: 1. Start isolated app. 2. Inspect listener addresses. 3. GET state with allowed host, hostile Host, then hostile Origin.
cases.expected: Only loopback listener; allowed read succeeds; both hostile requests rejected 403.

cases.steps: 1. Reset per trial. 2. POST non-JSON, invalid length, then body >300,000 bytes. 3. Compare DB to baseline.
cases.expected: HTTP 400 for each; zero writes or executed payloads.

cases.steps: 1. Store source and model text containing HTML_JS. 2. Open capture, drafts, practice and source views. 3. Observe JS sentinel.
cases.expected: Payload displayed as text; sentinel stays false in all four views.

cases.steps: 1. Import readable.pdf and NOTE text. 2. Test F3 byte/page/character boundaries separately with parser stub. 3. Import empty.pdf/corrupt.pdf.
cases.expected: At-limit validator accepts; above-limit rejects; zero text -> NO_TEXT; saved note remains.

cases.steps: 1. Submit count=1,20,0,21 using stub outputs. 2. Feed malformed/unsupported output. 3. Reload saved NOTE.
cases.expected: 1..20 accepted request count; 0/21 reject; no valid draft -> NO_SUPPORTED_ITEMS; NOTE unchanged.

cases.steps: 1. Seed >8,000 source characters. 2. Request guide with capture stub. 3. Inspect source payload, citations and coverage notice.
cases.expected: Evidence <=8,000 characters; every reference valid; omitted material explicitly warned.

cases.steps: 1. Pause model stub; submit task and read ID/status before releasing it. 2. Cancel queued/running trials. 3. Restart unfinished trial.
cases.expected: Submission precedes inference; valid states only; cancel prevents publication; restart -> INTERRUPTED.

cases.steps: 1. Freeze T0; reveal MC. 2. Rate again, good(initial), good(old=20) in reset trials. 3. Resend same eventId/payload.
cases.expected: Intervals 1,3,30 days; due=T0+days*86400; one update for duplicate event.

cases.steps: 1. Reset F1; updateNote with current base/revision. 2. Read original and new source. 3. Submit another update from stale base.
cases.expected: Original unchanged; one new revision; stale update rejects with no overwrite.

cases.steps: 1. Export CA to temp destination. 2. Verify manifest/version and file SHA-256s. 3. Repeat with denied/full destination.
cases.expected: Consistent snapshot/hashes; destination errors explicit; course data unchanged.

cases.steps: 1. Start job under verified D1 and consent=true. 2. Revoke consent or replace digest before publish. 3. Request another job.
cases.expected: Old job cannot publish; new model request gated until consent/profile readiness restored.

cases.steps: 1. Run the eight actions in Usability_Script.md with keyboard/screen reader. 2. Repeat three trials. 3. Record focus and announcements.
cases.expected: 24/24 actions work without mouse/trap; spoken labels meaningful; source return restores focus.

cases.steps: 1. Create clean staging account. 2. Follow release instructions without source edits. 3. Capture/import/create/accept/practice and record dependency failures.
cases.expected: One full run completes with zero source edits; manual Python setup may be documented fallback.

cases.steps: 1. Generate F4 (5 courses/5,000 passages). 2. Time ten N100 saves with perf_counter_ns. 3. Advance fake model clock to 60 seconds.
cases.expected: 10/10 acks <=1.000 s; deadline abort by 60.000 s; report raw timings/hardware.

cases.steps: 1. Collect >=20 permitted candidate questions with source IDs. 2. Label support, clarity, usefulness and failures. 3. Report counts and reviewer disagreements.
cases.expected: >=20 records/counts; zero unsupported learning-gain claims; provenance reported separately from correctness.

cases.steps: 1. Inventory required runtime services and credential prompts. 2. Execute manual workflow offline except loopback. 3. Inspect documented downloads/costs.
cases.expected: Zero required paid APIs/hosted app services; hardware/download costs disclosed.

cases.steps: 1. Inspect deployment and listener. 2. Attempt off-allowlist request as in TC-024. 3. Inspect account/isolation claims.
cases.expected: Loopback only; request rejected; no public/multi-user isolation claim.

cases.steps: 1. Run core flow on DEV-01. 2. Record CPU/RAM/GPU/runtime/browser and model digest. 3. Check bounded input behavior from TC-002/027.
cases.expected: One complete environment manifest and measured limits; zero universal laptop-fit claim.

cases.steps: 1. Inspect every fixture/evaluation source permission. 2. Inspect LICENSE/NOTICE and exact bundled dependencies/model terms. 3. Check release contains no course originals.
cases.expected: 100% source inventory has permission/provenance; required notices present; zero bundled unlicensed course files.

cases.steps: 1. Compare actual notebook hours with plan weekly. 2. Check 20% task buffer and protected gates. 3. Apply 4-hour availability scenario.
cases.expected: Owner/scope recorded; lower-capacity shortfall triggers replan, not an unsupported completion claim.
